production_notes: Production icons contain artwork only; spell names and costs are not baked into them.
Each icon uses one dominant visual idea and is designed to read at approximately 40 px.
Lighting is consistently motivated from the upper-left.
Spellstorm and Scorch Mark use the lightning palette because their paid-in element overrides discipline palette.
